title: Aquazone: Desktop Life Option Disc Series 1: Angel Fish
native_title: アクアゾーン・オプション・ディスク・シリーズ１ ～エンゼル・フィッシュ～
overview:
The AQUAZONE world expands even further with new fish, water plants, accessories and background images!

This is the first option disc for Aquazone, the tropical fish tank simulator. It brings angelfish to raise in your virtual aquarium, along with new items to decorate the tank.

- New fish: angelfish
- New water plant: cabomba
- New accessories: Amazon River driftwood, an ultramarine stone, a ship's wheel and a Venus de Milo statue
- Six new background images
- Requires the Aquazone Sega Saturn disc

新しい魚、水草、アクセサリー、背景画によってさらに拡がるAQUAZONEワールド!
